I think the behaviour system is doing well
Hi,

I saw the other post with complains about the behaviour system. I just wanted to say that I think it's doing fine from the limited game experience I've had so far. I was positively surprised some company managed to implement a system that moderately makes people censor themselves a little bit in terms of toxicity. When I joined games I felt a certain amount of silence in certain situations where I'd have expected flame, but sometimes people still speak their minds. Which is great. I feel like the system has multiple ways of awarding you when you act positively, and still lets you say things when you feel you really need to (in due form). Doing that with a scoring system is ingenious. However, I feel like a certain amount and intensity of low behaviour should be punished more strongly, including, say, the incantation for someone else to "go kill himself" and comparable. (I'd say a hard 2 month chat ban for that for instance, not just lower the score).

In this forum, people also report about some of those very hostile and low insults, I haven't had much of that until now, just profanity and quite inappropriate stuff, including someone with a profile picture of an internationally largely known child abuser. I don't see how that is not moderated more strongly since it's very easy to see. This person complained in a thread below that he got a low behaviour score from a lot of reports. Well, I guess some people just need to keep receiving the message until they bother to wrap their minds around it (is it that difficult to understand?) ...

I am quite amazed about DotA2 in total.

Thanks to whoever is behind this.
